_units: native HUF model units, game axes (x lateral, y up, z back=+). Chin-to-sole H = 1.0761; h = (y + 0.697) / H.
_baseline: Applied to the approved Chun-Li source; reproduces the v8 reference-fit decisions that remain supported and replaces those that the 2026-10-06 brief rules out.

_removed.bust_lowering: Withdrawn: derived from a sports-bra contour (nipple position / inframammary structure must not be inferred from the clothed reference). Breast geometry returns to the approved source.
_removed.glute_lower_fill: Withdrawn: derived from the gluteal fold at the shorts hem (garment seam / compression).

waist_ribcage._why: Exposed-skin band h 0.72-0.785. Source pinches in a V at h 0.784 (40 deg concave crease); v8 moved the pinch onto the first loop above the locked seam (38-42 deg crease, in-game flank notch). Target is one smooth contour: seam unchanged, gentle descent to a broad minimum ~0.086 at h 0.76, steady rise into the lower ribcage (matches the reference from h 0.76 up).

hip_radial._why: Source hip/trochanter band (h 0.56-0.69) carried an isolated lateral shelf, ~1.1-1.5 %H per side wider than the reference outline; v8's x-only narrowing with a z-band protection flattened the lateral hip (toon-outlined plane in game). Same magnitude as v8, applied as a radial shrink toward the pelvis axis with a wide angular plateau so the lateral hip stays rounded; anterior hip crease and glute apex are outside the window.

forearm_thickening._why: Visible skin: reference forearm 10-15 % wider (h 0.64-0.72). v8 values, but tapered to zero by |x| 0.442 so the wrist seam crease is not increased (v8 raised it 26.6 -> 28.7 deg mean).
